title: Serve live, governed data in AI-built apps with Amazon Quick
summary: With Live Data in Apps in Amazon Quick, AI-built apps query your governed Quick Sight datasets in real time instead of static, build-time snapshots. Each query runs as the person viewing the app, so row-level and column-level security apply per reader. Learn how to build, publish
